240-728-5223-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5223-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3845-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

3129-4772-5478-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
3129-4772-5478-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1809-3617-7370.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Returned Pastcaller.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Returned Pastcaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

240-643-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-5231.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

204-206-1858-2056-2633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-206-1858-2056-2633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

3446-3532-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3446-3532-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

338-3490-4050-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4050-4268.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

413-1274-2086.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1274-4186-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-4506.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

678-1985-2034-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Liberated Livestock, adding {C}{C}.
When Liberated Livestock dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Liberated Livestock trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat, a 1/1 Bird, and a 2/4 Ox creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Liberated Livestock to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two of the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Liberated Livestock by paying {5}{W}.
Repeat.

413-1407-2615.notablePrerequisites: You do not control a Construct.
413-1407-2615.description:
Activate Dollhouse of Horrors by paying {1}, tapping it and exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Tree of Perdition that is a 0/0 Construct with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Tree of Perdition token, dealing 1 damage to the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or les life.

637-2292-5173-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Mortuary and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shambling Ghast on top of your library.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Shambling Ghast from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying {B}.
Repeat.

262-549-3713.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Steelfin Whale.
Steelfin Whale does not have summoning sickness.
262-549-3713.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference, triggering Steelfin Whale, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

240-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Egg or a creature with changeling.
240-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a nontoken Egg or a nontoken creature with changeling.
When the creature dies, Atla Palani and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing the creature from the top of your library and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the creature's power.
Repeat.

539-1847-2608-2757.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic land.
539-1847-2608-2757.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Derevi, untapping a basic land.
Activate The Golden Throne by tapping it and sacrificing Derevi, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Choose to return Derevi to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting Derevi onto the battlefield from the command zone.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Golden Throne.
Repeat.

1558-3868-5121.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight additional creatures, five of which must be Myrs.
1558-3868-5121.description:
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three creatures, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three Myrs, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 2 one additional time.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Urtet triggers, untapping each Myr you control.
Repeat step 2 two additional times.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

803-1636-4117-4338.notablePrerequisites:
Visara does not have summoning sickness.
"Cleric" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1636-4117-4338.description:
Activate Visara by tapping it, destroying any creature you control.
The creature dies, triggering Rotlung Reanimator, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1067-4222-4290.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Sculptor of Winter.
Sculptor of Winter does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1067-4222-4290.description:
Activate a land you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Rimefeather Owl by paying {1}{S}, putting a snow counter on the land, causing the land to become a snow permanent.
Activate Sculptor of Winter by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sculptor of Winter.
Activate the land with the snow counter on it by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.

337-447-776-1329.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-447-776-1329.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Gustha's Scepter to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Gustha's Scepter.
Cast Gustha's Scepter.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
